bodyHtml:
Mobile fleet

A cheaper, higher-performing mobile fleet

With Greenspector Studio, our expert partners can support you in managing your mobile fleet.

  • Help choosing devices before purchase
  • Identification of consumption or performance issues
  • Assessment of real battery wear before deciding on a replacement
  • Implementation of a Quality Gate to validate battery consumption of business apps before deployment

Choose and roll out devices with confidence. Extend the life of your mobile fleet, cut costs and reduce your environmental impact.

Device selection

Which device for your mobile fleet? A lab to help you decide

How do you make the right choice before ordering thousands of devices for field agents? What battery life should you expect? What will daily autonomy look like?

Together with our partners, we developed an objective, reliable measurement methodology to answer these questions. Using Greenspector Studio, our partner runs measurement campaigns on realistic, complete usage scenarios.

500,000+

smartphones and tablets already validated before purchase thanks to our measurements

4 to 5 years

of device retention without battery issues, for a lower TCO

Our partners' tests also cover other essentials: network attach quality, ruggedness, photo quality and more.

Learn more about our partners

Diagnostics

Identify a battery or performance issue

Your business app is slow, or drains the battery too fast. Users complain. How do you find the root cause?

The precision and stability of measurements with Greenspector Studio enable our partners to help. They run measurement campaigns on devices from your own fleet.

By varying test conditions — with or without MDM, different models, network connections, apps — they pinpoint the cause and recommend remediation actions.

This approach can also be preventive: for example, you can assess the impact of an Android version upgrade before rolling it out.

Quality Gate

Validate business apps before you deploy them

A single bug in a single business app can drain your devices' batteries and bring your teams to a halt!

Stop reacting after the fact: before each app deployment, validate battery consumption and performance.

It is straightforward:

  • an automated test of the critical journey in each app;
  • triggered automatically by your CI/CD or by your testers;
  • on your private test bench, with your own fleet devices, for tailored results.

Your employees do not live in a simulation. With Greenspector Studio, neither do your tests!

Request a demo
